# Estuary Arts
> Glass Art and Paint Landscapes · Parapara, Tasman 7182, New Zealand

Estuary Arts is an art studio and gallery in Parapara, Golden Bay, Tasman, New Zealand, by Rosie Little (dramatic acrylic and oil landscape paintings) and Bruce (kilnformed glass art pieces).

## Opening Hours
Open Wed–Sun, October to end of April.

- Home: https://www.estuaryarts.co.nz/
